1	#ifndef __CPU_O3_CHAOS_PROPAGATION_HH__
2	#define __CPU_O3_CHAOS_PROPAGATION_HH__
3	
4	// CHAOSPropagation — [LSU][OBS-L3] real L3 propagation-chain tracer for LSU
5	// non-PRF faults (central correction directive 2026-10-13: L3 must be a REAL
6	// propagation correlation, not commit-divergence counting and not a PRF
7	// liveness proxy). Observation-only for architectural state: it READS the
8	// fault-injection call path, the LSQ request/response path and the commit
9	// stream, and never writes any CPU state. The only writes are to
10	// prop_trace.csv.gz and its own registries/taint set.
11	//
12	// COVERED FAMILIES (v1): addrpath (CHAOSAddrPath, both the sendFragment
13	// post hook and the pushRequest PRE family) and cache (CHAOSCache data /
14	// data_shift field faults). lsqfwd / prefetch / exmod families are NOT
15	// wired — the driver does not pass --chaos_propagation for them and
16	// tools/lsu_l3_propagation.py reports them unsupported (honest).
17	//
18	// ============================ prop_trace.csv.gz v1 =========================
19	// First line (comment, exactly):
20	//   # lsu-propagation v1: node_id,tick,ptag,kind,dyn_inst_seq,request_id,
21	//   (continued) addr,phys_reg,arch_reg,detail
22	// Every following line is one CSV node:
23	//   node_id      sequential node counter, starts at 0
24	//   tick         curTick()
25	//   ptag         propagation tag (per-fault chain id, 1-based; 0 = rows not
26	//                bound to one chain, i.e. funnel rows)
27	//   kind         inj | addr_form | mem_req | resp | taint_reg | consumer |
28	//                errant_commit | funnel
29	//   dyn_inst_seq DynInst::seqNum of the involved dynamic instruction
30	//                ("" when not applicable)
31	//   request_id   Request::getReqInstSeqNum() — the request→dyn-inst binding
32	//                gem5 v25 actually maintains (gem5 v25 Request has NO unique
33	//                id(); CONTRACT DEVIATION, documented in the design doc)
34	//                ("" when not applicable / not stamped)
35	//   addr         hex, lowercase, no 0x prefix ("" when not applicable)
36	//   phys_reg     physical register index within its class
37	//                ("" when not applicable; the class is in detail k=v)
38	//   arch_reg     architectural register index ("" when not applicable)
39	//   detail       compact "k=v;k=v" fields, NO commas; numeric values are
40	//                decimal, address-bearing values are bare hex (no 0x)
41	// Numeric columns with no value are EMPTY STRINGS (never placeholders).
42	//
43	// kind semantics:
44	//   inj            the fault was injected (injector call site); detail
45	//                  carries site=, family=, mode/field=, old/new addrs...
46	//   addr_form      the erroneous address was formed (addrpath): addr column
47	//                  = new (corrupted) address; detail carries old_addr/new_addr
48	//   mem_req        a memory Request carrying the fault left the LSQ toward
49	//                  translation/memory (sendFragmentToTranslation); matched
50	//                  against the addr registry (addrpath: range overlap +
51	//                  dyn_inst_seq match) or the faulted-byte registry (cache:
52	//                  range overlap, SE vaddr==paddr assumption)
53	//   resp           the memory response delivering the fault returned to the
54	//                  CPU (completeDataAccess, pre-writeback); detail carries
55	//                  data_fnv (FNV-1a-64 of the response bytes) and fault=
56	//                  when the inst carries a fault
57	//   taint_reg      a load destination physical register received data
58	//                  delivered through the fault path and entered the taint
59	//                  set (resp + register writeback, completeDataAccess)
60	//   consumer       a committed instruction read a source phys reg in the
61	//                  taint set (Commit::commitHead anchor)
62	//   errant_commit  the FIRST commit on a fault path — either the faulting
63	//                  load itself committing its tainted dest, or the first
64	//                  consumer. Field-level "first wrong architectural commit"
65	//                  remains L2 commit_diff.first_errant_commit (authoritative);
66	//                  this node is the propagation-view alignment point.
67	//   funnel         attempted/eligible/injected funnel row (one per injection
68	//                  + one final per injector at exit); ptag=0. Written
69	//                  Z_SYNC_FLUSH-per-node so ABORTED runs keep the funnel
70	//                  (central requirement: abort samples must carry
71	//                  attempted/eligible).
72	//
73	// Crash durability (W2.1/W2.4 contract, CHAOSMicroSnap/CHAOSCommitTrace
74	// pattern): raw zlib gzFile at simout.resolve(trace_file) — NOT
75	// simout.create's gz streambuf. EVERY node is followed by
76	// gzflush(Z_SYNC_FLUSH), so an aborted run leaves every completed node
77	// readable (the file then lacks only the gzip trailer; the Python parser
78	// salvages the prefix and flags truncated=true). The trailer is written by
79	// gzclose in an exit callback (destructor is a backstop only — gem5's exit
80	// path does not reliably run SimObject destructors).
81	//
82	// Attachment (setter pattern, CHAOSCommitTrace/CHAOSMicroSnap): startup()
83	// dynamic_casts p.cpu to o3::CPU and sets BOTH
84	//   cpu->setChaosPropagation(this)          (LSQ-side hooks: lsq.cc,
85	//                                            lsq_unit.cc read it via
86	//                                            cpu->chaosPropagation)
87	//   cpu->o3Commit().setChaosPropagation(this) (commit.cc commitHead hook)
88	// CHAOSCache has no CPU pointer, so it reaches the tracer through the
89	// static instance() (single-core campaign; BaseCache::chaosVictimHook /
90	// chaosLsuF6Notify static-hook precedent).
91	//
92	// ===================== registries / taint set (v1 rules) ===================
93	// addr registry (addrpath): map<new_addr_base, {ptag, dyn_seq, size, tick}>.
94	//   A Request matches when [vaddr, vaddr+size) overlaps [base, base+size)
95	//   AND req->getReqInstSeqNum() == dyn_seq (the faulted request belongs to
96	//   the faulting instruction; replays of the same inst via savedRequest
97	//   legitimately re-match — the corrupted vaddr/addr is baked into the
98	//   reused LSQRequest). Entries expire addrExpiryTicks after registration
99	//   (lazy sweep on insert/lookup) to bound address-reuse misattribution.
100	// faulted-byte registry (cache): map over [byte_addr, byte_end) ranges
101	//   (single byte for data faults; whole block for data_shift; metadata
102	//   field faults tag/valid/dirty/coh and the victim path register NO range —
103	//   their chain honestly stops at the inj node).
104	// taint set: map<(classValue, phys idx), {ptag, taintor_seq}>.
105	//   + taint_reg at completeDataAccess (resp hit + needWBToRegister +
106	//     NoFault + not squashed — exactly the condition under which
107	//     LSQUnit::writeback performs completeAcc and writes the PRF).
108	//   + consumer at commitHead when a source phys reg is tainted.
109	//   + dest re-taint when a consumer commits (its dests carry the wrong
110	//     value onward); clean-overwrite erase when an UNRELATED producer
111	//     commits onto a tainted phys cell (the cell is rewritten with a fresh,
112	//     untainted value — bounds stale taint after phys-reg recycling).
113	//   + the tainting load's own commit keeps its dest taint (taintor_seq
114	//     match) — that commit IS the first architectural materialization.
115	//   Squash-race residual (documented): a load tainted at writeback then
116	//     squashed before commit can leave stale taint on a recycled phys reg;
117	//     the clean-overwrite rule bounds it; no squash hook in v1.
118	// errant_commit: once per run (first overall). Single-fault campaign
119	//   (maxFaults=1) ⇒ one ptag; multi-fault runs attribute the node to the
120	//   first involved chain (detail says which).
121

123	
124	#include <cstdint>
125	#include <map>
126	#include <string>
127	#include <utility>
128	
129	#include "base/types.hh"
130	#include "mem/request.hh"          // RequestPtr (CHAOSAddrPath.hh precedent)
131	#include "params/CHAOSPropagation.hh"
132	#include "sim/sim_object.hh"
133	#include "base/output.hh"

136	namespace gem5 { namespace o3 { class CPU; } }
137	namespace gem5 { namespace o3 { class DynInst; } }
138	namespace gem5 { class Packet; }
139	
140	namespace gem5
141	{
142	
143	class CHAOSPropagation : public SimObject
144	{
145	  public:
146	    CHAOSPropagation(const CHAOSPropagationParams &p);
147	    ~CHAOSPropagation();
148	
149	    // CHAOSCache (no CPU pointer) reaches the tracer through this static
150	    // (single-instance assumption: single-core campaign; the static-hook
151	    // precedent is BaseCache::chaosVictimHook / chaosLsuF6Notify).
152	    static CHAOSPropagation *instance() { return chaos_instance; }
153	
154	    void startup() override;
155	
156	    // ---- injector-facing registration (fault-injection time) --------------
157	    // addrpath family: an AGU address fault just mutated a request address
158	    // (old_addr→new_addr; sizes as known at the site, 0 = unknown for the
159	    // post hook). Allocates a ptag, writes the inj + addr_form nodes and
160	    // registers [new_addr, new_addr+new_size) in the addr registry.
161	    // Returns the ptag (0 = tracer disabled / no-op).
162	    uint64_t registerInjection(const char *site, uint64_t dyn_inst_seq,
163	                               Addr old_addr, Addr new_addr, bool is_load,
164	                               unsigned old_size, unsigned new_size);
165	
166	    // cache family: a CHAOSCache fault just landed on block_addr.
167	    //   byte_offset >= 0 : data fault on one byte (registry range =
168	    //                      [block+off, block+off+1))
169	    //   byte_offset == -1: whole-block fault (data_shift; registry range =
170	    //                      [block, block+block_size))
171	    //   byte_offset == -2: metadata field fault (tag/valid/dirty/coh) or the
172	    //                      victim path — inj node only, NO delivery tracking
173	    //                      (the chain honestly stops at inj).
174	    uint64_t registerCacheFault(Addr block_addr, int byte_offset,
175	                                Addr block_size, const char *field);
176	
177	    // Funnel row (attempted/eligible/injected as of NOW). Called by the
178	    // injectors at every successful injection AND at their exit callbacks
179	    // (final counts). Per-node Z_SYNC_FLUSH ⇒ abort-survivable.
180	    void noteFunnel(const char *site, uint64_t attempted, uint64_t eligible,
181	                    uint64_t injected);
182	
183	    // ---- pipeline hooks (read-only w.r.t. CPU state) -----------------------
184	    // LSQ::LSQRequest::sendFragmentToTranslation: the fragment Request is
185	    // about to leave for translation/memory. Writes a mem_req node when it
186	    // matches the addr registry (addrpath) or the faulted-byte registry
187	    // (cache).
188	    void noteMemRequest(const char *site, uint64_t dyn_inst_seq,
189	                        const RequestPtr &req);
190	
191	    // LSQUnit::completeDataAccess (pre-writeback, squashed-guarded inside):
192	    // writes a resp node when the packet delivers a registered fault, and —

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""test_lsu_prop_fields.py — [MDSPEC][H0] 表 11 统一 PROP-EVT 字段解析测试。

规格（主文档 11.传播事件字段规范，24 字段）+ 计划 Task H0：
- 统一事件行 schema：全部注册字段按规范序发射；缺失字段输出空值不省略；
  evidence_status 缺省 observed（规格 11 末行：防止把缺失事件解释为未传播）。
- 发射/解析同源：Python 字段注册表必须与 CHAOSPropagation.hh 的 C++ 注册表
  逐项相等（同名同序）——双源漂移在这里被钉死。
- Unknown 语义（Review Focus #3）：链断于 Ln → provable_to=Ln, beyond=Unknown，
  不得输出 Masked（离线推断禁止）。
用法：python3 tests/test_lsu_prop_fields.py   （退出码 0=全 PASS）
"""
import sys
from pathlib import Path

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = HERE.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "tools"))

import lsu_prop_fields as P  # noqa: E402

FAILED = []


def check(name, cond, detail=""):
    if cond:
        print(f"  PASS {name}")
    else:
        print(f"  FAIL {name} {detail}")
        FAILED.append(name)


def main():
    # ---- 1. 发射/解析同源：Python 注册表 == C++ 注册表（同名同序） ----
    print("[1] registry same-source (python == CHAOSPropagation.hh)")
    hh = (ROOT / "CHAOS/gem5/src/cpu/o3/CHAOSPropagation/CHAOSPropagation.hh").read_text()
    begin = hh.index("PROP_EVT_FIELDS[] = {")
    end = hh.index("};", begin)
    import re
    cpp_fields = re.findall(r'"([a-z_0-9]+)"', hh[begin:end])
    check("cpp registry non-empty", len(cpp_fields) >= 38, f"got {len(cpp_fields)}")
    check("python registry == cpp registry",
          P.PROP_EVT_FIELDS == cpp_fields,
          f"py={P.PROP_EVT_FIELDS[:4]}... cpp={cpp_fields[:4]}...")
    check("registry has all spec-11 mandatory fields",
          all(f in P.PROP_EVT_FIELDS for f in [
              "run_id", "sample_run_id", "fault_id", "event_id",
              "parent_event_id", "tick", "cycle", "core_id", "thread_id",
              "dyn_inst_seq", "commit_seq", "pc", "opcode", "lq_idx", "sq_idx",
              "request_id", "walk_id", "mshr_id", "fill_id", "pf_request_id",
              "va", "pa", "cache_line", "set", "way", "entry_index", "field",
              "before", "after", "state_before", "state_after", "arch_reg",
              "phys_reg", "detection_layer", "contained", "outcome",
              "oracle_diff", "evidence_status"]))

    # ---- 2. 全字段行逐项还原 ----
    print("[2] full-field line roundtrip")
    vals = {f: f"v_{f}" for f in P.PROP_EVT_FIELDS}
    line = "PROP-EVT: " + " ".join(f"{k}={v}" for k, v in vals.items())
    evt = P.parse_line(line)
    check("parsed non-None", evt is not None)
    check("every field restored", all(evt.get(f) == vals[f] for f in P.PROP_EVT_FIELDS),
          str({f: evt.get(f) for f in P.PROP_EVT_FIELDS if evt.get(f) != vals[f]}))
    check("non-prop line rejected", P.parse_line("random log line") is None)

    # ---- 3. 缺字段行 → 空值；evidence_status 语义缺省 ----
    print("[3] missing fields -> empty values, evidence default observed")
    partial = "PROP-EVT: kind=inj event_id=0 fault_id=1 tick=100 dyn_inst_seq=42"
    evt2 = P.parse_line(partial)
    check("present fields parsed",
          evt2["kind"] == "inj" and evt2["event_id"] == "0"
          and evt2["dyn_inst_seq"] == "42")
    check("absent fields -> empty string",
          evt2.get("pc", "X") == "" and evt2.get("va", "X") == ""
          and evt2.get("walk_id", "X") == "")
    check("evidence_status absent -> default observed",
          P.evidence_status_of(evt2) == "observed")
    check("evidence_status explicit preserved",
          P.evidence_status_of({"evidence_status": "missing"}) == "missing")

    # ---- 4. 链断裂 → Unknown（不得 Masked）----
    print("[4] chain break -> provable_to + beyond=Unknown (never Masked)")
    chain = [
        P.parse_line("PROP-EVT: kind=inj event_id=0 fault_id=1 tick=10 "
                     "detection_layer="),
        P.parse_line("PROP-EVT: kind=mem_req event_id=1 parent_event_id=0 "
                     "fault_id=1 tick=20"),
    ]
    verdict = P.provable_to(chain)
    check("provable_to == L2", verdict["provable_to"] == "L2", str(verdict))
    check("beyond == Unknown", verdict["beyond"] == "Unknown", str(verdict))
    check("never Masked", "Masked" not in str(verdict))
    # 全链：inj(L0) addr_form(L1) mem_req(L2) resp(L3) taint_reg/consumer(L4)
    #       errant_commit(L4)
    full = [P.parse_line("PROP-EVT: kind=%s event_id=%d fault_id=1" % (k, i))
            for i, k in enumerate(["inj", "addr_form", "mem_req", "resp",
                                   "taint_reg", "consumer", "errant_commit"])]
    v2 = P.provable_to(full)
    check("full chain provable_to == L4", v2["provable_to"] == "L4", str(v2))
    # 空链（无事件）→ 诚实 L0 都不可证
    v3 = P.provable_to([])
    check("empty chain -> provable_to None/before-L0",
          v3["provable_to"] in (None, "", "none"), str(v3))
    check("empty chain beyond Unknown", v3["beyond"] == "Unknown", str(v3))

    # ---- 5. read_events：gz/普通文件 + 截断容错 ----
    print("[5] read_events file ingestion (plain + truncated gz)")
    import gzip
    import tempfile
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
        plain = Path(td) / "prop_evt.txt"
        plain.write_text(line + "\n" + partial + "\n")
        evts, trunc = P.read_events(plain)
        check("plain file 2 events", len(evts) == 2 and not trunc)
        gzp = Path(td) / "prop_evt.txt.gz"
        with gzip.open(gzp, "wb") as f:
            f.write(line.encode())  # 无换行结尾 = 模拟 Z_SYNC_FLUSH 截断
        evts2, trunc2 = P.read_events(gzp)
        check("truncated gz salvaged + flagged",
              trunc2 is True and len(evts2) >= 1,
              f"trunc={trunc2} n={len(evts2)}")

    print()
    if FAILED:
        print(f"FAILED ({len(FAILED)}): {FAILED}")
        return 1
    print("ALL PASS")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""test_lsu_prop_fields.py — [MDSPEC][H0] 表 11 统一 PROP-EVT 字段解析测试。

规格（主文档 11.传播事件字段规范，24 字段）+ 计划 Task H0：
- 统一事件行 schema：全部注册字段按规范序发射；缺失字段输出空值不省略；
  evidence_status 缺省 observed（规格 11 末行：防止把缺失事件解释为未传播）。
- 发射/解析同源：Python 字段注册表必须与 CHAOSPropagation.hh 的 C++ 注册表
  逐项相等（同名同序）——双源漂移在这里被钉死。
- Unknown 语义（Review Focus #3）：链断于 Ln → provable_to=Ln, beyond=Unknown，
  不得输出 Masked（离线推断禁止）。
用法：python3 tests/test_lsu_prop_fields.py   （退出码 0=全 PASS）
"""
import sys
from pathlib import Path

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = HERE.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "tools"))

import lsu_prop_fields as P  # noqa: E402

FAILED = []


def check(name, cond, detail=""):
    if cond:
        print(f"  PASS {name}")
    else:
        print(f"  FAIL {name} {detail}")
        FAILED.append(name)


def main():
    # ---- 1. 发射/解析同源：Python 注册表 == C++ 注册表（同名同序） ----
    print("[1] registry same-source (python == CHAOSPropagation.hh)")
    hh = (ROOT / "CHAOS/gem5/src/cpu/o3/CHAOSPropagation/CHAOSPropagation.hh").read_text()
    begin = hh.index("PROP_EVT_FIELDS[] = {")
    end = hh.index("};", begin)
    import re
    cpp_fields = re.findall(r'"([a-z_0-9]+)"', hh[begin:end])
    check("cpp registry non-empty", len(cpp_fields) >= 38, f"got {len(cpp_fields)}")
    check("python registry == cpp registry",
          P.PROP_EVT_FIELDS == cpp_fields,
          f"py={P.PROP_EVT_FIELDS[:4]}... cpp={cpp_fields[:4]}...")
    check("registry has all spec-11 mandatory fields",
          all(f in P.PROP_EVT_FIELDS for f in [
              "run_id", "sample_run_id", "fault_id", "event_id",
              "parent_event_id", "tick", "cycle", "core_id", "thread_id",
              "dyn_inst_seq", "commit_seq", "pc", "opcode", "lq_idx", "sq_idx",
              "request_id", "walk_id", "mshr_id", "fill_id", "pf_request_id",
              "va", "pa", "cache_line", "set", "way", "entry_index", "field",
              "before", "after", "state_before", "state_after", "arch_reg",
              "phys_reg", "detection_layer", "contained", "outcome",
              "oracle_diff", "evidence_status"]))

    # ---- 2. 全字段行逐项还原 ----
    print("[2] full-field line roundtrip")
    vals = {f: f"v_{f}" for f in P.PROP_EVT_FIELDS}
    line = "PROP-EVT: " + " ".join(f"{k}={v}" for k, v in vals.items())
    evt = P.parse_line(line)
    check("parsed non-None", evt is not None)
    check("every field restored", all(evt.get(f) == vals[f] for f in P.PROP_EVT_FIELDS),
          str({f: evt.get(f) for f in P.PROP_EVT_FIELDS if evt.get(f) != vals[f]}))
    check("non-prop line rejected", P.parse_line("random log line") is None)

    # ---- 3. 缺字段行 → 空值；evidence_status 语义缺省 ----
    print("[3] missing fields -> empty values, evidence default observed")
    partial = "PROP-EVT: kind=inj event_id=0 fault_id=1 tick=100 dyn_inst_seq=42"
    evt2 = P.parse_line(partial)
    check("present fields parsed",
          evt2["kind"] == "inj" and evt2["event_id"] == "0"
          and evt2["dyn_inst_seq"] == "42")
    check("absent fields -> empty string",
          evt2.get("pc", "X") == "" and evt2.get("va", "X") == ""
          and evt2.get("walk_id", "X") == "")
    check("evidence_status absent -> default observed",
          P.evidence_status_of(evt2) == "observed")
    check("evidence_status explicit preserved",
          P.evidence_status_of({"evidence_status": "missing"}) == "missing")

    # ---- 4. 链断裂 → Unknown（不得 Masked）----
    print("[4] chain break -> provable_to + beyond=Unknown (never Masked)")
    chain = [
        P.parse_line("PROP-EVT: kind=inj event_id=0 fault_id=1 tick=10 "
                     "detection_layer="),
        P.parse_line("PROP-EVT: kind=mem_req event_id=1 parent_event_id=0 "
                     "fault_id=1 tick=20"),
    ]
    verdict = P.provable_to(chain)
    check("provable_to == L2", verdict["provable_to"] == "L2", str(verdict))
    check("beyond == Unknown", verdict["beyond"] == "Unknown", str(verdict))
    check("never Masked", "Masked" not in str(verdict))
    # 全链：inj(L0) addr_form(L1) mem_req(L2) resp(L3) taint_reg/consumer(L4)
    #       errant_commit(L4)
    full = [P.parse_line("PROP-EVT: kind=%s event_id=%d fault_id=1" % (k, i))
            for i, k in enumerate(["inj", "addr_form", "mem_req", "resp",
                                   "taint_reg", "consumer", "errant_commit"])]
    v2 = P.provable_to(full)
    check("full chain provable_to == L4", v2["provable_to"] == "L4", str(v2))
    # 空链（无事件）→ 诚实 L0 都不可证
    v3 = P.provable_to([])
    check("empty chain -> provable_to None/before-L0",
          v3["provable_to"] in (None, "", "none"), str(v3))
    check("empty chain beyond Unknown", v3["beyond"] == "Unknown", str(v3))

    # ---- 5. read_events：gz/普通文件 + 截断容错 ----
    print("[5] read_events file ingestion (plain + truncated gz)")
    import gzip
    import tempfile
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
        plain = Path(td) / "prop_evt.txt"
        plain.write_text(line + "\n" + partial + "\n")
        evts, trunc = P.read_events(plain)
        check("plain file 2 events", len(evts) == 2 and not trunc)
        gzp = Path(td) / "prop_evt.txt.gz"
        with gzip.open(gzp, "wb") as f:
            f.write(line.encode())  # 无换行结尾 = 模拟 Z_SYNC_FLUSH 截断
        evts2, trunc2 = P.read_events(gzp)
        check("truncated gz salvaged + flagged",
              trunc2 is True and len(evts2) >= 1,
              f"trunc={trunc2} n={len(evts2)}")

    print()
    if FAILED:
        print(f"FAILED ({len(FAILED)}): {FAILED}")
        return 1
    print("ALL PASS")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""test_lsu_prop_fields.py — [MDSPEC][H0] 表 11 统一 PROP-EVT 字段解析测试。

规格（主文档 11.传播事件字段规范，24 字段）+ 计划 Task H0：
- 统一事件行 schema：全部注册字段按规范序发射；缺失字段输出空值不省略；
  evidence_status 缺省 observed（规格 11 末行：防止把缺失事件解释为未传播）。
- 发射/解析同源：Python 字段注册表必须与 CHAOSPropagation.hh 的 C++ 注册表
  逐项相等（同名同序）——双源漂移在这里被钉死。
- Unknown 语义（Review Focus #3）：链断于 Ln → provable_to=Ln, beyond=Unknown，
  不得输出 Masked（离线推断禁止）。
用法：python3 tests/test_lsu_prop_fields.py   （退出码 0=全 PASS）
"""
import sys
from pathlib import Path

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = HERE.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "tools"))

import lsu_prop_fields as P  # noqa: E402

FAILED = []


def check(name, cond, detail=""):
    if cond:
        print(f"  PASS {name}")
    else:
        print(f"  FAIL {name} {detail}")
        FAILED.append(name)


def main():
    # ---- 1. 发射/解析同源：Python 注册表 == C++ 注册表（同名同序） ----
    print("[1] registry same-source (python == CHAOSPropagation.hh)")
    hh = (ROOT / "CHAOS/gem5/src/cpu/o3/CHAOSPropagation/CHAOSPropagation.hh").read_text()
    begin = hh.index("PROP_EVT_FIELDS[] = {")
    end = hh.index("};", begin)
    import re
    cpp_fields = re.findall(r'"([a-z_0-9]+)"', hh[begin:end])
    check("cpp registry non-empty", len(cpp_fields) >= 38, f"got {len(cpp_fields)}")
    check("python registry == cpp registry",
          P.PROP_EVT_FIELDS == cpp_fields,
          f"py={P.PROP_EVT_FIELDS[:4]}... cpp={cpp_fields[:4]}...")
    check("registry has all spec-11 mandatory fields",
          all(f in P.PROP_EVT_FIELDS for f in [
              "run_id", "sample_run_id", "fault_id", "event_id",
              "parent_event_id", "tick", "cycle", "core_id", "thread_id",
              "dyn_inst_seq", "commit_seq", "pc", "opcode", "lq_idx", "sq_idx",
              "request_id", "walk_id", "mshr_id", "fill_id", "pf_request_id",
              "va", "pa", "cache_line", "set", "way", "entry_index", "field",
              "before", "after", "state_before", "state_after", "arch_reg",
              "phys_reg", "detection_layer", "contained", "outcome",
              "oracle_diff", "evidence_status"]))

    # ---- 2. 全字段行逐项还原 ----
    print("[2] full-field line roundtrip")
    vals = {f: f"v_{f}" for f in P.PROP_EVT_FIELDS}
    line = "PROP-EVT: " + " ".join(f"{k}={v}" for k, v in vals.items())
    evt = P.parse_line(line)
    check("parsed non-None", evt is not None)
    check("every field restored", all(evt.get(f) == vals[f] for f in P.PROP_EVT_FIELDS),
          str({f: evt.get(f) for f in P.PROP_EVT_FIELDS if evt.get(f) != vals[f]}))
    check("non-prop line rejected", P.parse_line("random log line") is None)

    # ---- 3. 缺字段行 → 空值；evidence_status 语义缺省 ----
    print("[3] missing fields -> empty values, evidence default observed")
    partial = "PROP-EVT: kind=inj event_id=0 fault_id=1 tick=100 dyn_inst_seq=42"
    evt2 = P.parse_line(partial)
    check("present fields parsed",
          evt2["kind"] == "inj" and evt2["event_id"] == "0"
          and evt2["dyn_inst_seq"] == "42")
    check("absent fields -> empty string",
          evt2.get("pc", "X") == "" and evt2.get("va", "X") == ""
          and evt2.get("walk_id", "X") == "")
    check("evidence_status absent -> default observed",
          P.evidence_status_of(evt2) == "observed")
    check("evidence_status explicit preserved",
          P.evidence_status_of({"evidence_status": "missing"}) == "missing")

    # ---- 4. 链断裂 → Unknown（不得 Masked）----
    print("[4] chain break -> provable_to + beyond=Unknown (never Masked)")
    chain = [
        P.parse_line("PROP-EVT: kind=inj event_id=0 fault_id=1 tick=10 "
                     "detection_layer="),
        P.parse_line("PROP-EVT: kind=mem_req event_id=1 parent_event_id=0 "
                     "fault_id=1 tick=20"),
    ]
    verdict = P.provable_to(chain)
    check("provable_to == L2", verdict["provable_to"] == "L2", str(verdict))
    check("beyond == Unknown", verdict["beyond"] == "Unknown", str(verdict))
    check("never Masked", "Masked" not in str(verdict))
    # 全链：inj(L0) addr_form(L1) mem_req(L2) resp(L3) taint_reg/consumer(L4)
    #       errant_commit(L4)
    full = [P.parse_line("PROP-EVT: kind=%s event_id=%d fault_id=1" % (k, i))
            for i, k in enumerate(["inj", "addr_form", "mem_req", "resp",
                                   "taint_reg", "consumer", "errant_commit"])]
    v2 = P.provable_to(full)
    check("full chain provable_to == L4", v2["provable_to"] == "L4", str(v2))
    # 空链（无事件）→ 诚实 L0 都不可证
    v3 = P.provable_to([])
    check("empty chain -> provable_to None/before-L0",
          v3["provable_to"] in (None, "", "none"), str(v3))
    check("empty chain beyond Unknown", v3["beyond"] == "Unknown", str(v3))

    # ---- 5. read_events：gz/普通文件 + 截断容错 ----
    print("[5] read_events file ingestion (plain + truncated gz)")
    import gzip
    import tempfile
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
        plain = Path(td) / "prop_evt.txt"
        plain.write_text(line + "\n" + partial + "\n")
        evts, trunc = P.read_events(plain)
        check("plain file 2 events", len(evts) == 2 and not trunc)
        gzp = Path(td) / "prop_evt.txt.gz"
        with gzip.open(gzp, "wb") as f:
            f.write(line.encode())  # 无换行结尾 = 模拟 Z_SYNC_FLUSH 截断
        evts2, trunc2 = P.read_events(gzp)
        check("truncated gz salvaged + flagged",
              trunc2 is True and len(evts2) >= 1,
              f"trunc={trunc2} n={len(evts2)}")

    print()
    if FAILED:
        print(f"FAILED ({len(FAILED)}): {FAILED}")
        return 1
    print("ALL PASS")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""lsu_prop_fields.py — [MDSPEC][H0] 表 11 统一 PROP-EVT 事件流解析器。

规格：主文档 11.传播事件字段规范（24 字段）+ 计划 Task H0。
- 发射端 CHAOSPropagation.cc emitPropEvt 与本模块共用同一字段注册表
  （同名同序）；tests/test_lsu_prop_fields.py 钉死双源一致。
- 行格式（发射端保证，解析端容错）：
    PROP-EVT: kind=<v> run_id=<v> ... evidence_status=<v>
  全部注册字段按规范序出现；缺失值留空（k=），键不省略。
- 解析端：行内缺键 → 填 ""；evidence_status 缺省 observed（规格 11 末行：
  防止把缺失事件解释为未传播）；非 PROP-EVT 行返回 None。
- .gz 截断容错：Z_SYNC_FLUSH 前缀可救（v1 lsu_l3_propagation 先例），
  截断必须置 truncated=True（诚实标记）。

Unknown 语义（Review Focus #3）：provable_to 只按在场事件的最大可证层级
判定；更高层一律 beyond=Unknown——绝不推断 Masked。
"""
import gzip
from pathlib import Path

# 与 CHAOSPropagation.hh 的 PROP_EVT_FIELDS[] 同名同序。
# kind 为事件语义首字段（规格表 11 未列——计划 H0 裁决：v1 已有 kind 概念，
# 无 kind 则事件不可分型；24 规格字段全部在列）。
PROP_EVT_FIELDS = [
    "kind", "run_id", "sample_run_id", "fault_id", "event_id",
    "parent_event_id", "tick", "cycle", "core_id", "thread_id",
    "dyn_inst_seq", "commit_seq", "pc", "opcode", "lq_idx", "sq_idx",
    "request_id", "walk_id", "mshr_id", "fill_id", "pf_request_id",
    "va", "pa", "cache_line", "set", "way", "entry_index", "field",
    "before", "after", "state_before", "state_after", "arch_reg",
    "phys_reg", "detection_layer", "contained", "outcome", "oracle_diff",
    "evidence_status",
]

_PREFIX = "PROP-EVT:"

# kind → 观测层级（v1 kinds 先行；H1-H7 钩子族经 register_kind_layer 注册
# 自己的映射——发射端 kind 命名与层级语义由各族任务定义）。
KIND_LAYER = {
    "inj": "L0", "addr_form": "L1", "mem_req": "L2", "resp": "L3",
    "taint_reg": "L4", "consumer": "L4", "errant_commit": "L4",
}
_LAYER_ORDER = ["L0", "L1", "L2", "L3", "L4", "L5"]


def register_kind_layer(kind, layer):
    """H 族钩子注册 kind→层级映射（layer ∈ L0..L5）。"""
    if layer not in _LAYER_ORDER:
        raise ValueError(f"layer must be one of {_LAYER_ORDER}, got {layer}")
    KIND_LAYER[kind] = layer


def parse_line(line):
    """解析一行 PROP-EVT；非 PROP-EVT 行返回 None。缺键填空串。"""
    line = line.strip()
    if not line.startswith(_PREFIX):
        return None
    evt = {f: "" for f in PROP_EVT_FIELDS}
    body = line[len(_PREFIX):].strip()
    if body:
        for tok in body.split():
            k, sep, v = tok.partition("=")
            if sep and k in evt:
                evt[k] = v
            # 未知键忽略（发射端注册表演进的读取容错；发射端自身对未知键
            # warn-once 并丢弃，双端一致）
    return evt


def evidence_status_of(evt):
    """规格 11：evidence_status 缺省 observed。"""
    return evt.get("evidence_status") or "observed"


def provable_to(events):
    """按在场事件判定最大可证层级。

    返回 {provable_to, beyond}：更高层一律 beyond=Unknown——链路缺失不得
    推断为 Masked（用户指令二.5 / Review Focus #3）。空链 = 连 L0 都
    不可证（provable_to=None）。
    """
    layers = [KIND_LAYER.get(e.get("kind", ""), None) for e in events]
    layers = [l for l in layers if l in _LAYER_ORDER]
    if not layers:
        return {"provable_to": None, "beyond": "Unknown"}
    deepest = max(layers, key=_LAYER_ORDER.index)
    if deepest == "L5":
        return {"provable_to": "L5", "beyond": ""}
    return {"provable_to": deepest, "beyond": "Unknown"}


def read_events(path):
    """读 PROP-EVT 流（.gz 或普通文件）。返回 (events, truncated)。"""
    path = Path(path)
    truncated = False
    events = []
    opener = gzip.open if path.suffix == ".gz" else open
    try:
        with opener(path, "rt", errors="replace") as f:
            for line in f:
                evt = parse_line(line)
                if evt is not None:
                    events.append(evt)
    except (EOFError, gzip.BadGzipFile, OSError):
        # Z_SYNC_FLUSH 前缀可救；截断标记（abort 样本契约）
        truncated = True
    return events, truncated

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""lsu_prop_fields.py — [MDSPEC][H0] 表 11 统一 PROP-EVT 事件流解析器。

规格：主文档 11.传播事件字段规范（24 字段）+ 计划 Task H0。
- 发射端 CHAOSPropagation.cc emitPropEvt 与本模块共用同一字段注册表
  （同名同序）；tests/test_lsu_prop_fields.py 钉死双源一致。
- 行格式（发射端保证，解析端容错）：
    PROP-EVT: kind=<v> run_id=<v> ... evidence_status=<v>
  全部注册字段按规范序出现；缺失值留空（k=），键不省略。
- 解析端：行内缺键 → 填 ""；evidence_status 缺省 observed（规格 11 末行：
  防止把缺失事件解释为未传播）；非 PROP-EVT 行返回 None。
- .gz 截断容错：Z_SYNC_FLUSH 前缀可救（v1 lsu_l3_propagation 先例），
  截断必须置 truncated=True（诚实标记）。

Unknown 语义（Review Focus #3）：provable_to 只按在场事件的最大可证层级
判定；更高层一律 beyond=Unknown——绝不推断 Masked。
"""
import gzip
from pathlib import Path

# 与 CHAOSPropagation.hh 的 PROP_EVT_FIELDS[] 同名同序。
# kind 为事件语义首字段（规格表 11 未列——计划 H0 裁决：v1 已有 kind 概念，
# 无 kind 则事件不可分型；24 规格字段全部在列）。
PROP_EVT_FIELDS = [
    "kind", "run_id", "sample_run_id", "fault_id", "event_id",
    "parent_event_id", "tick", "cycle", "core_id", "thread_id",
    "dyn_inst_seq", "commit_seq", "pc", "opcode", "lq_idx", "sq_idx",
    "request_id", "walk_id", "mshr_id", "fill_id", "pf_request_id",
    "va", "pa", "cache_line", "set", "way", "entry_index", "field",
    "before", "after", "state_before", "state_after", "arch_reg",
    "phys_reg", "detection_layer", "contained", "outcome", "oracle_diff",
    "evidence_status",
]

_PREFIX = "PROP-EVT:"

# kind → 观测层级（v1 kinds 先行；H1-H7 钩子族经 register_kind_layer 注册
# 自己的映射——发射端 kind 命名与层级语义由各族任务定义）。
KIND_LAYER = {
    "inj": "L0", "addr_form": "L1", "mem_req": "L2", "resp": "L3",
    "taint_reg": "L4", "consumer": "L4", "errant_commit": "L4",
}
_LAYER_ORDER = ["L0", "L1", "L2", "L3", "L4", "L5"]


def register_kind_layer(kind, layer):
    """H 族钩子注册 kind→层级映射（layer ∈ L0..L5）。"""
    if layer not in _LAYER_ORDER:
        raise ValueError(f"layer must be one of {_LAYER_ORDER}, got {layer}")
    KIND_LAYER[kind] = layer


def parse_line(line):
    """解析一行 PROP-EVT；非 PROP-EVT 行返回 None。缺键填空串。"""
    line = line.strip()
    if not line.startswith(_PREFIX):
        return None
    evt = {f: "" for f in PROP_EVT_FIELDS}
    body = line[len(_PREFIX):].strip()
    if body:
        for tok in body.split():
            k, sep, v = tok.partition("=")
            if sep and k in evt:
                evt[k] = v
            # 未知键忽略（发射端注册表演进的读取容错；发射端自身对未知键
            # warn-once 并丢弃，双端一致）
    return evt


def evidence_status_of(evt):
    """规格 11：evidence_status 缺省 observed。"""
    return evt.get("evidence_status") or "observed"


def provable_to(events):
    """按在场事件判定最大可证层级。

    返回 {provable_to, beyond}：更高层一律 beyond=Unknown——链路缺失不得
    推断为 Masked（用户指令二.5 / Review Focus #3）。空链 = 连 L0 都
    不可证（provable_to=None）。
    """
    layers = [KIND_LAYER.get(e.get("kind", ""), None) for e in events]
    layers = [l for l in layers if l in _LAYER_ORDER]
    if not layers:
        return {"provable_to": None, "beyond": "Unknown"}
    deepest = max(layers, key=_LAYER_ORDER.index)
    if deepest == "L5":
        return {"provable_to": "L5", "beyond": ""}
    return {"provable_to": deepest, "beyond": "Unknown"}


def read_events(path):
    """读 PROP-EVT 流（.gz 或普通文件）。返回 (events, truncated)。"""
    path = Path(path)
    truncated = False
    events = []
    opener = gzip.open if path.suffix == ".gz" else open
    try:
        with opener(path, "rt", errors="replace") as f:
            for line in f:
                evt = parse_line(line)
                if evt is not None:
                    events.append(evt)
    except (EOFError, gzip.BadGzipFile, OSError):
        # Z_SYNC_FLUSH 前缀可救；截断标记（abort 样本契约）
        truncated = True
    return events, truncated

<tool_use_error>String to replace not found in file.
String:     CHAOSPropagation *CHAOSPropagation::chaos_instance = nullptr;

    CHAOSPropagation::CHAOSPropagation(const CHAOSPropagationParams &p)
        : SimObject(p),
          cpu(p.cpu),
          trace_file(p.traceFile),
          write_log(p.writeLog),
          addr_expiry_ticks(p.addrExpiryTicks)
    {
        // CHAOSCache (no CPU pointer) reaches the tracer through the static
        // instance (single-core campaign; BaseCache::chaosVictim static
        // precedent). Last instance wins — one instance per run here.
        chaos_instance = this;

        if (write_log) {
            // Raw zlib gzFile at simout.resolve(trace_file) — NOT
            // simout.create's gz streambuf (that path only gzwrite()s and
            // zlib holds data until gzclose, so an aborted run loses the
            // file; CHAOSMicroSnap measured 0 bytes there). Every node
            // below is followed by gzflush(Z_SYNC_FLUSH) — the per-node
            // cost is irrelevant here (a handful of nodes per run).
            const std::string path = simout.resolve(trace_file);
            gz_file = gzopen(path.c_str(), "wb");
            if (!gz_file)
                panic("CHAOSPropagation: Could not open trace file %s",
                      path.c_str());
            const char *header =
                "# lsu-propagation v1: node_id,tick,ptag,kind,dyn_inst_seq,"
                "request_id,addr,phys_reg,arch_reg,detail\n";
            const int hlen = (int)strlen(header);
            if (gzwrite(gz_file, header, hlen) != hlen)
                panic("CHAOSPropagation: header write failed on %s",
                      path.c_str());
            gzflush(gz_file, Z_SYNC_FLUSH);

            // Normal-exit trailer: gzclose writes the gzip trailer. MUST be
            // an exit callback, not the destructor — gem5's exit path does
            // not reliably run SimObject destructors (CHAOSMicroSnap
            // measurement; CHAOSProbe exit-callback precedent). Aborted runs
            // never get here: they keep the Z_SYNC_FLUSH-ed truncated
            // stream, which tools/lsu_l3_propagation.py salvages.
            registerExitCallback([this]() {
                if (gz_file) {
                    gzclose(gz_file);
                    gz_file = nullptr;
                }
            });
        }
    }

    CHAOSPropagation::~CHAOSPropagation()
    {
        // Backstop only (exit callback above is the primary closer).
        if (gz_file) {
            gzclose(gz_file);
            gz_file = nullptr;
        }
        if (chaos_instance == this)
            chaos_instance = nullptr;
    }

    void
    CHAOSPropagation::startup()
    {
        SimObject::startup();
        auto *o3 = dynamic_cast<o3::CPU *>(cpu);
        if (!o3) {
            warn("CHAOSPropagation: cpu is not an O3CPU; tracer disabled.\n");
            return;
        }
        o3cpu = o3;

from m5.params import *
from m5.SimObject import SimObject

# CHAOSPropagation — [LSU][OBS-L3] real L3 propagation-chain tracer for LSU
# non-PRF faults (central correction directive 2026-10-13). READ-ONLY for
# architectural/µarch state: it observes the injector call path, the LSQ
# request/response path and the commit stream, and writes one CSV node per
# propagation event into prop_trace.csv.gz (pinned v1 format — see
# CHAOSPropagation.hh). NOT an injector: attaching it must leave the
# workload FINAL checksum byte-identical (CHAOSMicroSnap/CHAOSCommitTrace
# hard-gate precedent). Consumed by tools/lsu_l3_propagation.py
# (COVERED_FAMILIES = addrpath + cache; lsqfwd/prefetch/exmod stay
# unsupported, honestly).
class CHAOSPropagation(SimObject):
    type = 'CHAOSPropagation'
    cxx_class = 'gem5::CHAOSPropagation'
    cxx_header = "cpu/o3/CHAOSPropagation/CHAOSPropagation.hh"

    cpu = Param.BaseCPU(NULL, "Target CPU (must be an O3CPU)")

    traceFile = Param.String("prop_trace.csv.gz",
        "propagation trace output (relative to --outdir; .gz = auto gzip)")
    writeLog = Param.Bool(True,
        "write the propagation trace (false = attached but inert)")
    addrExpiryTicks = Param.Unsigned(20000000,
        "registry entry lifetime in ticks (0 = never expire); bounds "
        "address-reuse misattribution (lazy sweep on insert/lookup)")

board.chaos_msnap = msnap

if args.chaos_propagation:
    # [LSU][OBS-L3] CHAOSPropagation: O3-only, READ-ONLY L3 propagation
    # tracer. SELF-ATTACHES at startup() to BOTH cpu.chaosPropagation
    # (LSQ-side hooks in lsq.cc/lsq_unit.cc) and cpu.commit.chaosPropagation
    # (commitHead, the W2.1/W2.4 anchor); CHAOSCache reaches it through the
    # static instance(). Attaching changes nothing else — nullptr tracer =
    # every hook short-circuits (zero regression).
    # [LSU][OBS-FIX-6] 显式请求但二进制缺对象 → 致命错误（不静默降级）：
    # 需换用观测版二进制（lsu-obs worktree build，含 CHAOSPropagation）。
    if CHAOSPropagation is None:
        raise SystemExit(
            "[lsu_proxy] FATAL: --chaos_propagation 需要含 CHAOSPropagation "
            "的观测版 gem5 二进制（如 .claude/worktrees/lsu-obs/build/ARM/"
            "gem5.opt）；当前二进制早于该实现（提交 6c9d5930）。")
    prop = CHAOSPropagation(
        cpu=cpu0,
        traceFile=args.prop_trace_file,
        writeLog=True,
    )
    board.chaos_propagation = prop
    print(f"[lsu_proxy] CHAOSPropagation attached "
          f"(trace={args.prop_trace_file})")

## 现状一句话总结（详见 findings.md）

S1 四个 P0 单元 + S2/S3 六个 SE 单元 formal 已完成（单 cell × n=384）；核心格局：**乱序后端（PRF/RAT/LSQFwd）DUE 主导 92–100%，存储（L1D）SDC 主导 97.7%，执行/IQ/译码/BPU/RAS 全 Masked**。但存在：① mem_formal 全 Inactive（CHAOSMem 频率 bug，同 8bff9d1 修过的那类）；② 6 个 formal 结果未提交；③ 几乎所有 formal 只跑了 `protection_model=none` 单组、单 fault_model、target_index=0 单 cell —— 与设计文档 §1.2/§2.x C 的网格规格相差甚远；④ F5/F6 子模式（ROB spec_leak、IQ src_ready/tag_sub、LSQFwd fwd_source_sub/phaseOffset、TLB pfn→活页）全部 deferred；⑤ FS 管线（kp920_proxy_fs V110 参数、checkpoint 流水线、PTW H7 formal）未落地。

**Status: complete（2026-09-03）**

1. ✅ 6 个 formal 提交（d4c9e8b）：bpu/decode/ras/iq 全 Masked 384/384；mem 标注无效。

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""test_lsu_hook_lsq.py — [MDSPEC][H1] lsq.cc 统一事件钩子契约测试。

规格（表 9 缺失钩子列，39 RunID 共文）：
"在 src/cpu/o3/lsq.cc::pushRequest 与 LSQRequest::sendFragmentToTranslation
增加统一事件；把 lq_idx/sq_idx、PC/opcode、VA/PA、event_id/parent_event_id
写入 CHAOSPropagation"

契约：
- kind=lsq_push   → L1（EA/size/flags 进入 LSQRequest；pushRequest 入口）
- kind=lsq_sendfrag → L2（请求离开 LSQ 去翻译/访存；sendFragmentToTranslation）
- 必录字段（H1 家族，规格表 9 L1/L2 列）：
  lsq_push:    dyn_inst_seq, pc, opcode, lq_idx, sq_idx, va（fault_id 关联链）
  lsq_sendfrag: dyn_inst_seq, pc, opcode, request_id, va
- 发射端只对 fault-correlated 请求发射（ptag 链关联，量级可控）；
  fault_id 必须非 0（观测流 = 故障传播流，规格 11 语义）。

用法：python3 tests/test_lsu_hook_lsq.py   （退出码 0=全 PASS）
"""
import sys
from pathlib import Path

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = HERE.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "tools"))

import lsu_prop_fields as P  # noqa: E402

FAILED = []


def check(name, cond, detail=""):
    if cond:
        print(f"  PASS {name}")
    else:
        print(f"  FAIL {name} {detail}")
        FAILED.append(name)


def main():
    print("[1] H1 kind→层级与必录字段注册（lsu_prop_fields）")
    check("lsq_push -> L1", P.KIND_LAYER.get("lsq_push") == "L1",
          str(P.KIND_LAYER.get("lsq_push")))
    check("lsq_sendfrag -> L2", P.KIND_LAYER.get("lsq_sendfrag") == "L2",
          str(P.KIND_LAYER.get("lsq_sendfrag")))
    req_push = P.REQUIRED_FIELDS.get("lsq_push")
    req_frag = P.REQUIRED_FIELDS.get("lsq_sendfrag")
    check("lsq_push required fields",
          req_push is not None
          and all(f in req_push for f in ("dyn_inst_seq", "pc", "opcode",
                                          "lq_idx", "sq_idx", "va", "fault_id")))
    check("lsq_sendfrag required fields",
          req_frag is not None
          and all(f in req_frag for f in ("dyn_inst_seq", "pc", "opcode",
                                          "request_id", "va", "fault_id")))

    print("[2] 契约行校验（validate_event）")
    good_push = P.parse_line(
        "PROP-EVT: kind=lsq_push fault_id=1 dyn_inst_seq=42 pc=4096 "
        "opcode=ldr lq_idx=3 sq_idx=-1 va=1ffff70 sample_run_id=0")
    check("complete lsq_push validates",
          good_push is not None and P.validate_event(good_push) == [])
    bad_push = P.parse_line(
        "PROP-EVT: kind=lsq_push fault_id=1 dyn_inst_seq=42")
    errs = P.validate_event(bad_push)
    check("missing pc/opcode/lq_idx/sq_idx/va flagged",
          len(errs) >= 5, str(errs))
    good_frag = P.parse_line(
        "PROP-EVT: kind=lsq_sendfrag fault_id=1 dyn_inst_seq=42 pc=4096 "
        "opcode=ldr request_id=42 va=1ffff70")
    check("complete lsq_sendfrag validates",
          good_frag is not None and P.validate_event(good_frag) == [])

    print("[3] fault_id 非 0（传播流语义）+ 层级推进")
    check("correlated event has fault_id != 0",
          good_push["fault_id"] == "1")
    chain = [P.parse_line("PROP-EVT: kind=inj fault_id=1 event_id=0"),
             good_push, good_frag,
             P.parse_line("PROP-EVT: kind=resp fault_id=1")]
    v = P.provable_to(chain)
    check("inj→lsq_push→lsq_sendfrag→resp chain reaches L3",
          v["provable_to"] == "L3", str(v))

    print()
    if FAILED:
        print(f"FAILED ({len(FAILED)}): {FAILED}")
        return 1
    print("ALL PASS")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""test_lsu_hook_lsq.py — [MDSPEC][H1] lsq.cc 统一事件钩子契约测试。

规格（表 9 缺失钩子列，39 RunID 共文）：
"在 src/cpu/o3/lsq.cc::pushRequest 与 LSQRequest::sendFragmentToTranslation
增加统一事件；把 lq_idx/sq_idx、PC/opcode、VA/PA、event_id/parent_event_id
写入 CHAOSPropagation"

契约：
- kind=lsq_push   → L1（EA/size/flags 进入 LSQRequest；pushRequest 入口）
- kind=lsq_sendfrag → L2（请求离开 LSQ 去翻译/访存；sendFragmentToTranslation）
- 必录字段（H1 家族，规格表 9 L1/L2 列）：
  lsq_push:    dyn_inst_seq, pc, opcode, lq_idx, sq_idx, va（fault_id 关联链）
  lsq_sendfrag: dyn_inst_seq, pc, opcode, request_id, va
- 发射端只对 fault-correlated 请求发射（ptag 链关联，量级可控）；
  fault_id 必须非 0（观测流 = 故障传播流，规格 11 语义）。

用法：python3 tests/test_lsu_hook_lsq.py   （退出码 0=全 PASS）
"""
import sys
from pathlib import Path

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = HERE.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "tools"))

import lsu_prop_fields as P  # noqa: E402

FAILED = []


def check(name, cond, detail=""):
    if cond:
        print(f"  PASS {name}")
    else:
        print(f"  FAIL {name} {detail}")
        FAILED.append(name)


def main():
    print("[1] H1 kind→层级与必录字段注册（lsu_prop_fields）")
    check("lsq_push -> L1", P.KIND_LAYER.get("lsq_push") == "L1",
          str(P.KIND_LAYER.get("lsq_push")))
    check("lsq_sendfrag -> L2", P.KIND_LAYER.get("lsq_sendfrag") == "L2",
          str(P.KIND_LAYER.get("lsq_sendfrag")))
    req_push = P.REQUIRED_FIELDS.get("lsq_push")
    req_frag = P.REQUIRED_FIELDS.get("lsq_sendfrag")
    check("lsq_push required fields",
          req_push is not None
          and all(f in req_push for f in ("dyn_inst_seq", "pc", "opcode",
                                          "lq_idx", "sq_idx", "va", "fault_id")))
    check("lsq_sendfrag required fields",
          req_frag is not None
          and all(f in req_frag for f in ("dyn_inst_seq", "pc", "opcode",
                                          "request_id", "va", "fault_id")))

    print("[2] 契约行校验（validate_event）")
    good_push = P.parse_line(
        "PROP-EVT: kind=lsq_push fault_id=1 dyn_inst_seq=42 pc=4096 "
        "opcode=ldr lq_idx=3 sq_idx=-1 va=1ffff70 sample_run_id=0")
    check("complete lsq_push validates",
          good_push is not None and P.validate_event(good_push) == [])
    bad_push = P.parse_line(
        "PROP-EVT: kind=lsq_push fault_id=1 dyn_inst_seq=42")
    errs = P.validate_event(bad_push)
    check("missing pc/opcode/lq_idx/sq_idx/va flagged",
          len(errs) >= 5, str(errs))
    good_frag = P.parse_line(
        "PROP-EVT: kind=lsq_sendfrag fault_id=1 dyn_inst_seq=42 pc=4096 "
        "opcode=ldr request_id=42 va=1ffff70")
    check("complete lsq_sendfrag validates",
          good_frag is not None and P.validate_event(good_frag) == [])

    print("[3] fault_id 非 0（传播流语义）+ 层级推进")
    check("correlated event has fault_id != 0",
          good_push["fault_id"] == "1")
    chain = [P.parse_line("PROP-EVT: kind=inj fault_id=1 event_id=0"),
             good_push, good_frag,
             P.parse_line("PROP-EVT: kind=resp fault_id=1")]
    v = P.provable_to(chain)
    check("inj→lsq_push→lsq_sendfrag→resp chain reaches L3",
          v["provable_to"] == "L3", str(v))

    print()
    if FAILED:
        print(f"FAILED ({len(FAILED)}): {FAILED}")
        return 1
    print("ALL PASS")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

---

**Status: complete（2026-09-03）**

2. ✅ CHAOSMem 频率 bug 修复（b7433dd）：ratio 由时钟频率按 gem5 舍入规则计算（C2→385，C0→500）。真机验证 Tick 精确等于 first_clock×ratio。
3. ✅ mem_formal 重跑（d88dcc7）：**VALID，384/384 Masked，P_SDC=0% [0,1.0]**——DRAM 后备字节被 L1/L2 缓存掩盖（与 L1D 97.7% SDC 对照鲜明）。附带修复 campaign.py --jobs>1 pickle bug（_PoolRep 模块级类；此前所有 formal 都是串行跑的，掩盖了此 bug）。

**验收**：✅ mem formal n_valid=384>0；✅ reg_chain golden f247ef3fe6f02cfd 回归通过。

**Status: complete（2026-09-03）**

"""lsu_prop_fields.py — [MDSPEC][H0] 表 11 统一 PROP-EVT 事件流解析器。

规格：主文档 11.传播事件字段规范（24 字段）+ 计划 Task H0。

- 行格式（发射端保证，解析端容错）：
    PROP-EVT: kind=<v> run_id=<v> ... evidence_status=<v>
  全部注册字段按规范序出现；缺失值留空（k=），键不省略。
- 解析端：行内缺键 → 填 ""；evidence_status 缺省 observed（规格 11 末行：
  防止把缺失事件解释为未传播）；非 PROP-EVT 行返回 None。
- .gz 截断容错：Z_SYNC_FLUSH 前缀可救（v1 lsu_l3_propagation 先例），
  截断必须置 truncated=True（诚实标记）。

Unknown 语义（Review Focus #3）：provable_to 只按在场事件的最大可证层级
判定；更高层一律 beyond=Unknown——绝不推断 Masked。

# 无 kind 则事件不可分型；24 规格字段全部在列）。
PROP_EVT_FIELDS = [
    "kind", "run_id", "sample_run_id", "fault_id", "event_id",

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""test_lsu_hook_tlb.py — [MDSPEC][H2] TLB 翻译统一事件钩子契约测试。

规格（表 9 缺失钩子列，39 RunID 共文）：
"在 src/arch/arm/tlb.cc 与 table_walker.cc 增加 translate/walk/refill 节点"

SE 实证约束（CHAOS/gem5/src/arch/arm/tlb.cc:173 注释）：SE 经 translateSe
翻译、**从不进入 TLB::lookup**；LSQ 的翻译漏斗是
arch/arm/mmu.cc::MMU::translateTiming（SE/FS 共用，lsq.cc
sendFragmentToTranslation 直接调用）。故 H2 的 translate 节点挂
mmu.cc::translateTiming（SE 立即可验证，pilot A01-F0-W3 是 SE 负载）；
tlb.cc lookup 与 table_walker.cc walk/refill 节点属 FS 路径——推迟到
FS TLB 轨道（W4 TLB-AliasPerm 负载本就 BLOCKED），不静默跳过。

契约：
- kind=tlb_translate → L2（VA→PA 翻译请求离开 LSQ 后进入 MMU 漏斗）
- 必录字段：fault_id, dyn_inst_seq, va, request_id（pa 在入口未定，留空
  诚实；PA 物化由 resp 节点与 lsq_sendfrag→resp 链覆盖）
- 发射端只对 fault-correlated 请求发射（规格 11 传播流语义）。

用法：python3 tests/test_lsu_hook_tlb.py   （退出码 0=全 PASS）
"""
import sys
from pathlib import Path

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = HERE.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "tools"))

import lsu_prop_fields as P  # noqa: E402

FAILED = []


def check(name, cond, detail=""):
    if cond:
        print(f"  PASS {name}")
    else:
        print(f"  FAIL {name} {detail}")
        FAILED.append(name)


def main():
    print("[1] H2 kind→层级与必录字段注册")
    check("tlb_translate -> L2", P.KIND_LAYER.get("tlb_translate") == "L2",
          str(P.KIND_LAYER.get("tlb_translate")))
    req = P.REQUIRED_FIELDS.get("tlb_translate")
    check("tlb_translate required fields",
          req is not None
          and all(f in req for f in ("fault_id", "dyn_inst_seq", "va",
                                     "request_id")))

    print("[2] 契约行校验")
    good = P.parse_line(
        "PROP-EVT: kind=tlb_translate fault_id=1 dyn_inst_seq=42 "
        "request_id=42 va=1ffff70 pa=")
    check("complete tlb_translate validates (pa empty = honest pending)",
          good is not None and P.validate_event(good) == [])
    bad = P.parse_line("PROP-EVT: kind=tlb_translate fault_id=1")
    errs = P.validate_event(bad)
    check("missing dyn_inst_seq/va/request_id flagged",
          len(errs) == 3, str(errs))

    print("[3] 链推进与层级语义")
    chain = [P.parse_line("PROP-EVT: kind=inj fault_id=1 event_id=0"),
             P.parse_line("PROP-EVT: kind=addr_form fault_id=1 event_id=1"),
             P.parse_line("PROP-EVT: kind=lsq_push fault_id=1 event_id=2"),
             P.parse_line("PROP-EVT: kind=tlb_translate fault_id=1 "
                          "event_id=3 dyn_inst_seq=42 request_id=42 va=1ffff70"),
             P.parse_line("PROP-EVT: kind=resp fault_id=1 event_id=4")]
    v = P.provable_to(chain)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""test_lsu_hook_tlb.py — [MDSPEC][H2] TLB 翻译统一事件钩子契约测试。

规格（表 9 缺失钩子列，39 RunID 共文）：
"在 src/arch/arm/tlb.cc 与 table_walker.cc 增加 translate/walk/refill 节点"

SE 实证约束（CHAOS/gem5/src/arch/arm/tlb.cc:173 注释）：SE 经 translateSe
翻译、**从不进入 TLB::lookup**；LSQ 的翻译漏斗是
arch/arm/mmu.cc::MMU::translateTiming（SE/FS 共用，lsq.cc
sendFragmentToTranslation 直接调用）。故 H2 的 translate 节点挂
mmu.cc::translateTiming（SE 立即可验证，pilot A01-F0-W3 是 SE 负载）；
tlb.cc lookup 与 table_walker.cc walk/refill 节点属 FS 路径——推迟到
FS TLB 轨道（W4 TLB-AliasPerm 负载本就 BLOCKED），不静默跳过。

契约：
- kind=tlb_translate → L2（VA→PA 翻译请求离开 LSQ 后进入 MMU 漏斗）
- 必录字段：fault_id, dyn_inst_seq, va, request_id（pa 在入口未定，留空
  诚实；PA 物化由 resp 节点与 lsq_sendfrag→resp 链覆盖）
- 发射端只对 fault-correlated 请求发射（规格 11 传播流语义）。

用法：python3 tests/test_lsu_hook_tlb.py   （退出码 0=全 PASS）
"""
import sys
from pathlib import Path

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = HERE.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "tools"))

import lsu_prop_fields as P  # noqa: E402

FAILED = []


def check(name, cond, detail=""):
    if cond:
        print(f"  PASS {name}")
    else:
        print(f"  FAIL {name} {detail}")
        FAILED.append(name)


def main():
    print("[1] H2 kind→层级与必录字段注册")
    check("tlb_translate -> L2", P.KIND_LAYER.get("tlb_translate") == "L2",
          str(P.KIND_LAYER.get("tlb_translate")))
    req = P.REQUIRED_FIELDS.get("tlb_translate")
    check("tlb_translate required fields",
          req is not None
          and all(f in req for f in ("fault_id", "dyn_inst_seq", "va",
                                     "request_id")))

    print("[2] 契约行校验")
    good = P.parse_line(
        "PROP-EVT: kind=tlb_translate fault_id=1 dyn_inst_seq=42 "
        "request_id=42 va=1ffff70 pa=")
    check("complete tlb_translate validates (pa empty = honest pending)",
          good is not None and P.validate_event(good) == [])
    bad = P.parse_line("PROP-EVT: kind=tlb_translate fault_id=1")
    errs = P.validate_event(bad)
    check("missing dyn_inst_seq/va/request_id flagged",
          len(errs) == 3, str(errs))

    print("[3] 链推进与层级语义")
    chain = [P.parse_line("PROP-EVT: kind=inj fault_id=1 event_id=0"),
             P.parse_line("PROP-EVT: kind=addr_form fault_id=1 event_id=1"),
             P.parse_line("PROP-EVT: kind=lsq_push fault_id=1 event_id=2"),
             P.parse_line("PROP-EVT: kind=tlb_translate fault_id=1 "
                          "event_id=3 dyn_inst_seq=42 request_id=42 va=1ffff70"),
             P.parse_line("PROP-EVT: kind=resp fault_id=1 event_id=4")]
    v = P.provable_to(chain)
    check("inj→addr_form→lsq_push→tlb_translate→resp reaches L3",
          v["provable_to"] == "L3", str(v))

    print("[4] FS 路径推迟如实记录（不静默）")
    # tlb_walk / tlb_refill 尚未注册 = FS 轨道未实现的诚实状态；
    # 注册它们是 FS TLB 轨道任务（W4 解锁后）的义务。
    check("tlb_walk/tlb_refill NOT yet registered (honest fs-pending)",
          "tlb_walk" not in P.KIND_LAYER
          and "tlb_refill" not in P.KIND_LAYER)
    evt = P.parse_line("PROP-EVT: kind=tlb_walk fault_id=1")
    check("unregistered kind rejected by validate_event",
          len(P.validate_event(evt)) >= 1)

    print()
    if FAILED:
        print(f"FAILED ({len(FAILED)}): {FAILED}")
        return 1
    print("ALL PASS")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

# 下一步计划：鲲鹏920 SDC 故障注入 — S2/S3 收尾 → 网格深化 → F5/F6 → FS → v1.1 补救轮

> 依据 `docs/KUNPENG920-故障注入方案详细工程设计.md`（§3.1 阶段表）× 仓库实际进展（HEAD af64ef7 + 未提交 formal 结果）编写。
> **v1.1 补救轮（Phase 8–12）** 依据工程设计文档 v1.1（§1.3 故障模型必跑矩阵 + §1.7 负载/oracle 纪律 + §2.3/2.6/2.8/2.17）× `KUNPENG920-v1.1补救轮执行计划.md`；落地仓库 `gem5-fi/`（分支 `fix/fi-tool-correctness`，真 HEAD `4bf8d0d` = 238 commits）。
> 本计划是**工作计划**；证据审计结论见 `findings.md`。

## Goal

把"每个单元 1 个 cell 的 n=384 formal"推进为设计文档要求的**有意义网格 + protection-aware 对照 + F5/F6 机理模式 + FS 管线**，期间修复已发现的工具正确性 bug（本分支主题），最终产出可信的 §4.1 逃逸分解与 §4.2 保护投资排序。

## 现状一句话总结（详见 findings.md）

S1 四个 P0 单元 + S2/S3 六个 SE 单元 formal 已完成（单 cell × n=384）；核心格局：**乱序后端（PRF/RAT/LSQFwd）DUE 主导 92–100%，存储（L1D）SDC 主导 97.7%，执行/IQ/译码/BPU/RAS 全 Masked**。但存在：① mem_formal 全 Inactive（CHAOSMem 频率 bug，同 8bff9d1 修过的那类）；② 6 个 formal 结果未提交；③ 几乎所有 formal 只跑了 `protection_model=none` 单组、单 fault_model、target_index=0 单 cell —— 与设计文档 §1.2/§2.x C 的网格规格相差甚远；④ F5/F6 子模式（ROB spec_leak、IQ src_ready/tag_sub、LSQFwd fwd_source_sub/phaseOffset、TLB pfn→活页）全部 deferred；⑤ FS 管线（kp920_proxy_fs V110 参数、checkpoint 流水线、PTW H7 formal）未落地。

---

## Phase 1 — 工具正确性 + 在手结果落盘（本分支主题，最高优先）

**Status: complete（2026-09-03）**

1. ✅ 6 个 formal 提交（d4c9e8b）：bpu/decode/ras/iq 全 Masked 384/384；mem 标注无效。
2. ✅ CHAOSMem 频率 bug 修复（b7433dd）：ratio 由时钟频率按 gem5 舍入规则计算（C2→385，C0→500）。真机验证 Tick 精确等于 first_clock×ratio。
3. ✅ mem_formal 重跑（d88dcc7）：**VALID，384/384 Masked，P_SDC=0% [0,1.0]**——DRAM 后备字节被 L1/L2 缓存掩盖（与 L1D 97.7% SDC 对照鲜明）。附带修复 campaign.py --jobs>1 pickle bug（_PoolRep 模块级类；此前所有 formal 都是串行跑的，掩盖了此 bug）。

**验收**：✅ mem formal n_valid=384>0；✅ reg_chain golden f247ef3fe6f02cfd 回归通过。

## Phase 2 — protection-aware 第二组（§1.2 核心缺口，改结论级别的补强）

**Status: complete（2026-09-03）**

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""lsu_prop_fields.py — [MDSPEC][H0] 表 11 统一 PROP-EVT 事件流解析器。

规格：主文档 11.传播事件字段规范（24 字段）+ 计划 Task H0。
- 发射端 CHAOSPropagation.cc emitPropEvt 与本模块共用同一字段注册表
  （同名同序）；tests/test_lsu_prop_fields.py 钉死双源一致。
- 行格式（发射端保证，解析端容错）：
    PROP-EVT: kind=<v> run_id=<v> ... evidence_status=<v>
  全部注册字段按规范序出现；缺失值留空（k=），键不省略。
- 解析端：行内缺键 → 填 ""；evidence_status 缺省 observed（规格 11 末行：
  防止把缺失事件解释为未传播）；非 PROP-EVT 行返回 None。
- .gz 截断容错：Z_SYNC_FLUSH 前缀可救（v1 lsu_l3_propagation 先例），
  截断必须置 truncated=True（诚实标记）。

Unknown 语义（Review Focus #3）：provable_to 只按在场事件的最大可证层级
判定；更高层一律 beyond=Unknown——绝不推断 Masked。
"""
import gzip
from pathlib import Path

# 与 CHAOSPropagation.hh 的 PROP_EVT_FIELDS[] 同名同序。
# kind 为事件语义首字段（规格表 11 未列——计划 H0 裁决：v1 已有 kind 概念，
# 无 kind 则事件不可分型；24 规格字段全部在列）。
PROP_EVT_FIELDS = [
    "kind", "run_id", "sample_run_id", "fault_id", "event_id",
    "parent_event_id", "tick", "cycle", "core_id", "thread_id",
    "dyn_inst_seq", "commit_seq", "pc", "opcode", "lq_idx", "sq_idx",
    "request_id", "walk_id", "mshr_id", "fill_id", "pf_request_id",
    "va", "pa", "cache_line", "set", "way", "entry_index", "field",
    "before", "after", "state_before", "state_after", "arch_reg",
    "phys_reg", "detection_layer", "contained", "outcome", "oracle_diff",
    "evidence_status",
]

_PREFIX = "PROP-EVT:"

# kind → 观测层级（v1 kinds 先行；H1-H7 钩子族经 register_kind_layer 注册
# 自己的映射——发射端 kind 命名与层级语义由各族任务定义）。
KIND_LAYER = {
    "inj": "L0", "addr_form": "L1", "mem_req": "L2", "resp": "L3",
    "taint_reg": "L4", "consumer": "L4", "errant_commit": "L4",
    # [MDSPEC][H1] lsq.cc 统一事件（表 9：L1=EA/size/flags 进入 LSQRequest；
    # L2=请求离开 LSQ 去翻译/访存）
    "lsq_push": "L1", "lsq_sendfrag": "L2",
}
_LAYER_ORDER = ["L0", "L1", "L2", "L3", "L4", "L5"]

# 家族必录字段契约（kind → 必须非空的注册表字段；表 9 必监控列）。
# 发射端（C++ 钩子）与本校验共用此表——契约测试 tests/test_lsu_hook_*.py
# 逐族钉死。
REQUIRED_FIELDS = {
    "lsq_push": ["fault_id", "dyn_inst_seq", "pc", "opcode",
                 "lq_idx", "sq_idx", "va"],
    "lsq_sendfrag": ["fault_id", "dyn_inst_seq", "pc", "opcode",
                     "request_id", "va"],
}


def register_kind_layer(kind, layer):
    """H 族钩子注册 kind→层级映射（layer ∈ L0..L5）。"""
    if layer not in _LAYER_ORDER:
        raise ValueError(f"layer must be one of {_LAYER_ORDER}, got {layer}")
    KIND_LAYER[kind] = layer


def validate_event(evt):
    """按家族契约校验：kind 必须已知 + REQUIRED_FIELDS 全部非空。

    返回错误列表（空 = 合法）。观测流是故障传播流（规格 11），
    fault_id 非空即链关联在场——非关联观测事件不得入流。
    """
    kind = evt.get("kind", "")
    errs = []
    if kind not in KIND_LAYER:
        errs.append(f"unknown kind '{kind}' (not in KIND_LAYER)")
        return errs
    for f in REQUIRED_FIELDS.get(kind, []):
        if not evt.get(f, ""):
            errs.append(f"{kind}: required field '{f}' missing/empty")
    return errs


def parse_line(line):
    """解析一行 PROP-EVT；非 PROP-EVT 行返回 None。缺键填空串。"""
    line = line.strip()
    if not line.startswith(_PREFIX):
        return None
    evt = {f: "" for f in PROP_EVT_FIELDS}
    body = line[len(_PREFIX):].strip()
    if body:
        for tok in body.split():
            k, sep, v = tok.partition("=")
            if sep:
                # 注册表键必有（空值合法）；注册表外的家族键（表 11 24 字段
                # 之外的 asid/hit 等）保留在 dict 中供家族消费
                evt[k] = v
    return evt


def evidence_status_of(evt):
    """规格 11：evidence_status 缺省 observed。"""
    return evt.get("evidence_status") or "observed"


def provable_to(events):
    """按在场事件判定最大可证层级。

    返回 {provable_to, beyond}：更高层一律 beyond=Unknown——链路缺失不得
    推断为 Masked（用户指令二.5 / Review Focus #3）。空链 = 连 L0 都
    不可证（provable_to=None）。
    """
    layers = [KIND_LAYER.get(e.get("kind", ""), None) for e in events]
    layers = [l for l in layers if l in _LAYER_ORDER]
    if not layers:
        return {"provable_to": None, "beyond": "Unknown"}
    deepest = max(layers, key=_LAYER_ORDER.index)
    if deepest == "L5":
        return {"provable_to": "L5", "beyond": ""}
    return {"provable_to": deepest, "beyond": "Unknown"}


def read_events(path):
    """读 PROP-EVT 流（.gz 或普通文件）。返回 (events, truncated)。"""
    path = Path(path)
    truncated = False
    events = []
    opener = gzip.open if path.suffix == ".gz" else open
    try:
        with opener(path, "rt", errors="replace") as f:
            for line in f:
                evt = parse_line(line)
                if evt is not None:
                    events.append(evt)
    except (EOFError, gzip.BadGzipFile, OSError):
        # Z_SYNC_FLUSH 前缀可救；截断标记（abort 样本契约）
        truncated = True
    return events, truncated

    # SE 不经 TLB::lookup——tlb.cc:173 实证。tlb_walk/tlb_refill 属 FS
    # 路径，推迟到 FS TLB 轨道，未注册 = 诚实缺席）
    "tlb_translate": "L2",
}
_LAYER_ORDER = ["L0", "L1", "L2", "L3", "L4", "L5"]

# 家族必录字段契约（kind → 必须非空的注册表字段；表 9 必监控列）。
# 发射端（C++ 钩子）与本校验共用此表——契约测试 tests/test_lsu_hook_*.py
# 逐族钉死。
REQUIRED_FIELDS = {
    "lsq_push": ["fault_id", "dyn_inst_seq", "pc", "opcode",
                 "lq_idx", "sq_idx", "va"],
    "lsq_sendfrag": ["fault_id", "dyn_inst_seq", "pc", "opcode",
                     "request_id", "va"],
}


def register_kind_layer(kind, layer):
    """H 族钩子注册 kind→层级映射（layer ∈ L0..L5）。"""
    if layer not in _LAYER_ORDER:
        raise ValueError(f"layer must be one of {_LAYER_ORDER}, got {layer}")
    KIND_LAYER[kind] = layer


def validate_event(evt):
    """按家族契约校验：kind 必须已知 + REQUIRED_FIELDS 全部非空。

    返回错误列表（空 = 合法）。观测流是故障传播流（规格 11），
    fault_id 非空即链关联在场——非关联观测事件不得入流。
    """
    kind = evt.get("kind", "")
    errs = []
    if kind not in KIND_LAYER:
        errs.append(f"unknown kind '{kind}' (not in KIND_LAYER)")
        return errs
    for f in REQUIRED_FIELDS.get(kind, []):
        if not evt.get(f, ""):
            errs.append(f"{kind}: required field '{f}' missing/empty")
    return errs


def parse_line(line):
    """解析一行 PROP-EVT；非 PROP-EVT 行返回 None。缺键填空串。"""
    line = line.strip()
    if not line.startswith(_PREFIX):
        return None
    evt = {f: "" for f in PROP_EVT_FIELDS}
    body = line[len(_PREFIX):].strip()
    if body:
        for tok in body.split():
            k, sep, v = tok.partition("=")
            if sep:
                # 注册表键必有（空值合法）；注册表外的家族键（表 11 24 字段
                # 之外的 asid/hit 等）保留在 dict 中供家族消费
                evt[k] = v
    return evt


def evidence_status_of(evt):
    """规格 11：evidence_status 缺省 observed。"""
    return evt.get("evidence_status") or "observed"


def provable_to(events):
    """按在场事件判定最大可证层级。

    返回 {provable_to, beyond}：更高层一律 beyond=Unknown——链路缺失不得
    推断为 Masked（用户指令二.5 / Review Focus #3）。空链 = 连 L0 都
    不可证（provable_to=None）。
    """
    layers = [KIND_LAYER.get(e.get("kind", ""), None) for e in events]
    layers = [l for l in layers if l in _LAYER_ORDER]
    if not layers:
        return {"provable_to": None, "beyond": "Unknown"}
    deepest = max(layers, key=_LAYER_ORDER.index)
    if deepest == "L5":
        return {"provable_to": "L5", "beyond": ""}
    return {"provable_to": deepest, "beyond": "Unknown"}


def read_events(path):
    """读 PROP-EVT 流（.gz 或普通文件）。返回 (events, truncated)。"""
    path = Path(path)
    truncated = False
    events = []
    opener = gzip.open if path.suffix == ".gz" else open
    try:
        with opener(path, "rt", errors="replace") as f:
            for line in f:
                evt = parse_line(line)
                if evt is not None:
                    events.append(evt)
    except (EOFError, gzip.BadGzipFile, OSError):
        # Z_SYNC_FLUSH 前缀可救；截断标记（abort 样本契约）
        truncated = True
    return events, truncated

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""test_lsu_hook_lq.py — [MDSPEC][H7] LQ 逐事件钩子契约测试。

规格（表 9 H7）：src/cpu/o3/lsq_unit.cc insertLoad/read/checkViolations/
completeDataAccess 与 replay 的 lq_idx 生命周期。

契约（本提交覆盖 read/completeDataAccess 两个主生命周期点；insert 在
dispatch 期早于注入注册（PRE 族在 pushRequest 注入）——除 replay 外结构
性缺席，如实；checkViolations/replay 属 violation 路径，下一提交补）：
- kind=lq_read    → L3（load 的访存读发射；lsq_unit.cc read() 入口）
- kind=lq_complete→ L3（响应返回 LQ 表项；noteMemResponse 内，带 va/pa）
- 必录字段：
  lq_read:     fault_id, dyn_inst_seq, lq_idx, va
  lq_complete: fault_id, dyn_inst_seq, lq_idx, va, pa

用法：python3 tests/test_lsu_hook_lq.py   （退出码 0=全 PASS）
"""
import sys
from pathlib import Path

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = HERE.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "tools"))

import lsu_prop_fields as P  # noqa: E402

FAILED = []


def check(name, cond, detail=""):
    if cond:
        print(f"  PASS {name}")
    else:
        print(f"  FAIL {name} {detail}")
        FAILED.append(name)


def main():
    print("[1] H7 kind→层级与必录字段注册")
    check("lq_read -> L3", P.KIND_LAYER.get("lq_read") == "L3",
          str(P.KIND_LAYER.get("lq_read")))
    check("lq_complete -> L3", P.KIND_LAYER.get("lq_complete") == "L3",
          str(P.KIND_LAYER.get("lq_complete")))
    rr = P.REQUIRED_FIELDS.get("lq_read")
    rc = P.REQUIRED_FIELDS.get("lq_complete")
    check("lq_read required",
          rr is not None and all(f in rr for f in
                                 ("fault_id", "dyn_inst_seq", "lq_idx", "va")))
    check("lq_complete required",
          rc is not None and all(f in rc for f in
                                 ("fault_id", "dyn_inst_seq", "lq_idx",
                                  "va", "pa")))

    print("[2] 契约行校验")
    good_r = P.parse_line("PROP-EVT: kind=lq_read fault_id=1 dyn_inst_seq=42 "
                          "lq_idx=3 va=1ffff70")
    check("complete lq_read validates",
          good_r is not None and P.validate_event(good_r) == [])
    good_c = P.parse_line("PROP-EVT: kind=lq_complete fault_id=1 "
                          "dyn_inst_seq=42 lq_idx=3 va=1ffff70 pa=1ffff70")
    check("complete lq_complete validates",
          good_c is not None and P.validate_event(good_c) == [])
    bad = P.parse_line("PROP-EVT: kind=lq_read fault_id=1 dyn_inst_seq=42")
    check("missing lq_idx/va flagged", len(P.validate_event(bad)) == 2)

    print("[3] 链推进")
    chain = [P.parse_line("PROP-EVT: kind=%s fault_id=1 event_id=%d" % (k, i))
             for i, k in enumerate(["inj", "addr_form", "lsq_push",
                                    "lsq_sendfrag"])] + [good_r, good_c]
    v = P.provable_to(chain)
    check("full chain reaches L3", v["provable_to"] == "L3", str(v))

    print()
    if FAILED:
        print(f"FAILED ({len(FAILED)}): {FAILED}")
        return 1
    print("ALL PASS")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

性缺席，如实；checkViolations/replay 属 violation 路径，下一提交补）：
- kind=lq_read    → L3（load 的访存读发射；lsq_unit.cc read() 入口）
- kind=lq_complete→ L3（响应返回 LQ 表项；noteMemResponse 内，带 va/pa）
- 必录字段：
  lq_read:     fault_id, dyn_inst_seq, lq_idx, va
  lq_complete: fault_id, dyn_inst_seq, lq_idx, va, pa

用法：python3 tests/test_lsu_hook_lq.py   （退出码 0=全 PASS）
"""
import sys
from pathlib import Path

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = HERE.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "tools"))

import lsu_prop_fields as P  # noqa: E402

FAILED = []


def check(name, cond, detail=""):
    if cond:
        print(f"  PASS {name}")
    else:
        print(f"  FAIL {name} {detail}")
        FAILED.append(name)


def main():
    print("[1] H7 kind→层级与必录字段注册")
    check("lq_read -> L3", P.KIND_LAYER.get("lq_read") == "L3",
          str(P.KIND_LAYER.get("lq_read")))
    check("lq_complete -> L3", P.KIND_LAYER.get("lq_complete") == "L3",
          str(P.KIND_LAYER.get("lq_complete")))
    rr = P.REQUIRED_FIELDS.get("lq_read")
    rc = P.REQUIRED_FIELDS.get("lq_complete")
    check("lq_read required",
          rr is not None and all(f in rr for f in
                                 ("fault_id", "dyn_inst_seq", "lq_idx", "va")))
    check("lq_complete required",
          rc is not None and all(f in rc for f in
                                 ("fault_id", "dyn_inst_seq", "lq_idx",
                                  "va", "pa")))

    print("[2] 契约行校验")
    good_r = P.parse_line("PROP-EVT: kind=lq_read fault_id=1 dyn_inst_seq=42 "
                          "lq_idx=3 va=1ffff70")
    check("complete lq_read validates",
          good_r is not None and P.validate_event(good_r) == [])
    good_c = P.parse_line("PROP-EVT: kind=lq_complete fault_id=1 "
                          "dyn_inst_seq=42 lq_idx=3 va=1ffff70 pa=1ffff70")
    check("complete lq_complete validates",
          good_c is not None and P.validate_event(good_c) == [])
    bad = P.parse_line("PROP-EVT: kind=lq_read fault_id=1 dyn_inst_seq=42")
    check("missing lq_idx/va flagged", len(P.validate_event(bad)) == 2)

    print("[3] 链推进")
    chain = [P.parse_line("PROP-EVT: kind=%s fault_id=1 event_id=%d" % (k, i))
             for i, k in enumerate(["inj", "addr_form", "lsq_push",
                                    "lsq_sendfrag"])] + [good_r, good_c]
    v = P.provable_to(chain)
    check("full chain reaches L3", v["provable_to"] == "L3", str(v))

    print()
    if FAILED:
        print(f"FAILED ({len(FAILED)}): {FAILED}")
        return 1
    print("ALL PASS")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""lsu_prop_fields.py — [MDSPEC][H0] 表 11 统一 PROP-EVT 事件流解析器。

规格：主文档 11.传播事件字段规范（24 字段）+ 计划 Task H0。
- 发射端 CHAOSPropagation.cc emitPropEvt 与本模块共用同一字段注册表
  （同名同序）；tests/test_lsu_prop_fields.py 钉死双源一致。
- 行格式（发射端保证，解析端容错）：
    PROP-EVT: kind=<v> run_id=<v> ... evidence_status=<v>
  全部注册字段按规范序出现；缺失值留空（k=），键不省略。
- 解析端：行内缺键 → 填 ""；evidence_status 缺省 observed（规格 11 末行：
  防止把缺失事件解释为未传播）；非 PROP-EVT 行返回 None。
- .gz 截断容错：Z_SYNC_FLUSH 前缀可救（v1 lsu_l3_propagation 先例），
  截断必须置 truncated=True（诚实标记）。

Unknown 语义（Review Focus #3）：provable_to 只按在场事件的最大可证层级
判定；更高层一律 beyond=Unknown——绝不推断 Masked。
"""
import gzip
from pathlib import Path

# 与 CHAOSPropagation.hh 的 PROP_EVT_FIELDS[] 同名同序。
# kind 为事件语义首字段（规格表 11 未列——计划 H0 裁决：v1 已有 kind 概念，
# 无 kind 则事件不可分型；24 规格字段全部在列）。
PROP_EVT_FIELDS = [
    "kind", "run_id", "sample_run_id", "fault_id", "event_id",
    "parent_event_id", "tick", "cycle", "core_id", "thread_id",
    "dyn_inst_seq", "commit_seq", "pc", "opcode", "lq_idx", "sq_idx",
    "request_id", "walk_id", "mshr_id", "fill_id", "pf_request_id",
    "va", "pa", "cache_line", "set", "way", "entry_index", "field",
    "before", "after", "state_before", "state_after", "arch_reg",
    "phys_reg", "detection_layer", "contained", "outcome", "oracle_diff",
    "evidence_status",
]

_PREFIX = "PROP-EVT:"

# kind → 观测层级（v1 kinds 先行；H1-H7 钩子族经 register_kind_layer 注册
# 自己的映射——发射端 kind 命名与层级语义由各族任务定义）。
KIND_LAYER = {
    "inj": "L0", "addr_form": "L1", "mem_req": "L2", "resp": "L3",
    "taint_reg": "L4", "consumer": "L4", "errant_commit": "L4",
    # [MDSPEC][H1] lsq.cc 统一事件（表 9：L1=EA/size/flags 进入 LSQRequest；
    # L2=请求离开 LSQ 去翻译/访存）
    "lsq_push": "L1", "lsq_sendfrag": "L2",
    # [MDSPEC][H2] TLB 翻译统一事件（mmu.cc translateTiming = SE+FS 漏斗；
    # SE 不经 TLB::lookup——tlb.cc:173 实证。tlb_walk/tlb_refill 属 FS
    # 路径，推迟到 FS TLB 轨道，未注册 = 诚实缺席）
    "tlb_translate": "L2",
}
_LAYER_ORDER = ["L0", "L1", "L2", "L3", "L4", "L5"]

# 家族必录字段契约（kind → 必须非空的注册表字段；表 9 必监控列）。
# 发射端（C++ 钩子）与本校验共用此表——契约测试 tests/test_lsu_hook_*.py
# 逐族钉死。
REQUIRED_FIELDS = {
    "lsq_push": ["fault_id", "dyn_inst_seq", "pc", "opcode",
                 "lq_idx", "sq_idx", "va"],
    "lsq_sendfrag": ["fault_id", "dyn_inst_seq", "pc", "opcode",
                     "request_id", "va"],
    # [MDSPEC][H2] pa 入口未定留空（诚实 pending；PA 物化由 resp 节点覆盖）
    "tlb_translate": ["fault_id", "dyn_inst_seq", "va", "request_id"],
}


def register_kind_layer(kind, layer):
    """H 族钩子注册 kind→层级映射（layer ∈ L0..L5）。"""
    if layer not in _LAYER_ORDER:
        raise ValueError(f"layer must be one of {_LAYER_ORDER}, got {layer}")
    KIND_LAYER[kind] = layer


def validate_event(evt):
    """按家族契约校验：kind 必须已知 + REQUIRED_FIELDS 全部非空。

    返回错误列表（空 = 合法）。观测流是故障传播流（规格 11），
    fault_id 非空即链关联在场——非关联观测事件不得入流。
    """
    kind = evt.get("kind", "")
    errs = []
    if kind not in KIND_LAYER:
        errs.append(f"unknown kind '{kind}' (not in KIND_LAYER)")
        return errs
    for f in REQUIRED_FIELDS.get(kind, []):
        if not evt.get(f, ""):
            errs.append(f"{kind}: required field '{f}' missing/empty")
    return errs


def parse_line(line):
    """解析一行 PROP-EVT；非 PROP-EVT 行返回 None。缺键填空串。"""
    line = line.strip()
    if not line.startswith(_PREFIX):
        return None
    evt = {f: "" for f in PROP_EVT_FIELDS}
    body = line[len(_PREFIX):].strip()
    if body:
        for tok in body.split():
            k, sep, v = tok.partition("=")
            if sep:
                # 注册表键必有（空值合法）；注册表外的家族键（表 11 24 字段
                # 之外的 asid/hit 等）保留在 dict 中供家族消费
                evt[k] = v
    return evt


def evidence_status_of(evt):
    """规格 11：evidence_status 缺省 observed。"""
    return evt.get("evidence_status") or "observed"


def provable_to(events):
    """按在场事件判定最大可证层级。

    返回 {provable_to, beyond}：更高层一律 beyond=Unknown——链路缺失不得
    推断为 Masked（用户指令二.5 / Review Focus #3）。空链 = 连 L0 都
    不可证（provable_to=None）。
    """
    layers = [KIND_LAYER.get(e.get("kind", ""), None) for e in events]
    layers = [l for l in layers if l in _LAYER_ORDER]
    if not layers:
        return {"provable_to": None, "beyond": "Unknown"}
    deepest = max(layers, key=_LAYER_ORDER.index)
    if deepest == "L5":
        return {"provable_to": "L5", "beyond": ""}
    return {"provable_to": deepest, "beyond": "Unknown"}


def read_events(path):
    """读 PROP-EVT 流（.gz 或普通文件）。返回 (events, truncated)。"""
    path = Path(path)
    truncated = False
    events = []
    opener = gzip.open if path.suffix == ".gz" else open
    try:
        with opener(path, "rt", errors="replace") as f:
            for line in f:
                evt = parse_line(line)
                if evt is not None:
                    events.append(evt)
    except (EOFError, gzip.BadGzipFile, OSError):
        # Z_SYNC_FLUSH 前缀可救；截断标记（abort 样本契约）
        truncated = True
    return events, truncated

+    # [MDSPEC][H7] LQ 逐事件（表 9：lq_idx 生命周期；read/completion 属

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""lsu_prop_fields.py — [MDSPEC][H0] 表 11 统一 PROP-EVT 事件流解析器。

规格：主文档 11.传播事件字段规范（24 字段）+ 计划 Task H0。
- 发射端 CHAOSPropagation.cc emitPropEvt 与本模块共用同一字段注册表
  （同名同序）；tests/test_lsu_prop_fields.py 钉死双源一致。
- 行格式（发射端保证，解析端容错）：
    PROP-EVT: kind=<v> run_id=<v> ... evidence_status=<v>
  全部注册字段按规范序出现；缺失值留空（k=），键不省略。
- 解析端：行内缺键 → 填 ""；evidence_status 缺省 observed（规格 11 末行：
  防止把缺失事件解释为未传播）；非 PROP-EVT 行返回 None。
- .gz 截断容错：Z_SYNC_FLUSH 前缀可救（v1 lsu_l3_propagation 先例），
  截断必须置 truncated=True（诚实标记）。

Unknown 语义（Review Focus #3）：provable_to 只按在场事件的最大可证层级
判定；更高层一律 beyond=Unknown——绝不推断 Masked。
"""
import gzip
from pathlib import Path

# 与 CHAOSPropagation.hh 的 PROP_EVT_FIELDS[] 同名同序。
# kind 为事件语义首字段（规格表 11 未列——计划 H0 裁决：v1 已有 kind 概念，
# 无 kind 则事件不可分型；24 规格字段全部在列）。
PROP_EVT_FIELDS = [
    "kind", "run_id", "sample_run_id", "fault_id", "event_id",
    "parent_event_id", "tick", "cycle", "core_id", "thread_id",
    "dyn_inst_seq", "commit_seq", "pc", "opcode", "lq_idx", "sq_idx",
    "request_id", "walk_id", "mshr_id", "fill_id", "pf_request_id",
    "va", "pa", "cache_line", "set", "way", "entry_index", "field",
    "before", "after", "state_before", "state_after", "arch_reg",
    "phys_reg", "detection_layer", "contained", "outcome", "oracle_diff",
    "evidence_status",
]

_PREFIX = "PROP-EVT:"

# kind → 观测层级（v1 kinds 先行；H1-H7 钩子族经 register_kind_layer 注册
# 自己的映射——发射端 kind 命名与层级语义由各族任务定义）。
KIND_LAYER = {
    "inj": "L0", "addr_form": "L1", "mem_req": "L2", "resp": "L3",
    "taint_reg": "L4", "consumer": "L4", "errant_commit": "L4",
    # [MDSPEC][H1] lsq.cc 统一事件（表 9：L1=EA/size/flags 进入 LSQRequest；
    # L2=请求离开 LSQ 去翻译/访存）
    "lsq_push": "L1", "lsq_sendfrag": "L2",
    # [MDSPEC][H2] TLB 翻译统一事件（mmu.cc translateTiming = SE+FS 漏斗；
    # SE 不经 TLB::lookup——tlb.cc:173 实证。tlb_walk/tlb_refill 属 FS
    # 路径，推迟到 FS TLB 轨道，未注册 = 诚实缺席）
    "tlb_translate": "L2",
    # [MDSPEC][H7] LQ 逐事件（表 9：lq_idx 生命周期；read/completion 属
    # L3 访存发射与返回；insert 在 dispatch 期早于注入注册、结构性缺席）
    "lq_read": "L3", "lq_complete": "L3",
}
_LAYER_ORDER = ["L0", "L1", "L2", "L3", "L4", "L5"]

# 家族必录字段契约（kind → 必须非空的注册表字段；表 9 必监控列）。
# 发射端（C++ 钩子）与本校验共用此表——契约测试 tests/test_lsu_hook_*.py
# 逐族钉死。
REQUIRED_FIELDS = {
    "lsq_push": ["fault_id", "dyn_inst_seq", "pc", "opcode",
                 "lq_idx", "sq_idx", "va"],
    "lsq_sendfrag": ["fault_id", "dyn_inst_seq", "pc", "opcode",
                     "request_id", "va"],
    # [MDSPEC][H2] pa 入口未定留空（诚实 pending；PA 物化由 resp 节点覆盖）
    "tlb_translate": ["fault_id", "dyn_inst_seq", "va", "request_id"],
}


def register_kind_layer(kind, layer):
    """H 族钩子注册 kind→层级映射（layer ∈ L0..L5）。"""
    if layer not in _LAYER_ORDER:
        raise ValueError(f"layer must be one of {_LAYER_ORDER}, got {layer}")
    KIND_LAYER[kind] = layer


def validate_event(evt):
    """按家族契约校验：kind 必须已知 + REQUIRED_FIELDS 全部非空。

    返回错误列表（空 = 合法）。观测流是故障传播流（规格 11），
    fault_id 非空即链关联在场——非关联观测事件不得入流。
    """
    kind = evt.get("kind", "")
    errs = []
    if kind not in KIND_LAYER:
        errs.append(f"unknown kind '{kind}' (not in KIND_LAYER)")
        return errs
    for f in REQUIRED_FIELDS.get(kind, []):
        if not evt.get(f, ""):
            errs.append(f"{kind}: required field '{f}' missing/empty")
    return errs


def parse_line(line):
    """解析一行 PROP-EVT；非 PROP-EVT 行返回 None。缺键填空串。"""
    line = line.strip()
    if not line.startswith(_PREFIX):
        return None
    evt = {f: "" for f in PROP_EVT_FIELDS}
    body = line[len(_PREFIX):].strip()
    if body:
        for tok in body.split():
            k, sep, v = tok.partition("=")
            if sep:
                # 注册表键必有（空值合法）；注册表外的家族键（表 11 24 字段
                # 之外的 asid/hit 等）保留在 dict 中供家族消费
                evt[k] = v
    return evt


def evidence_status_of(evt):
    """规格 11：evidence_status 缺省 observed。"""
    return evt.get("evidence_status") or "observed"


def provable_to(events):
    """按在场事件判定最大可证层级。

    返回 {provable_to, beyond}：更高层一律 beyond=Unknown——链路缺失不得
    推断为 Masked（用户指令二.5 / Review Focus #3）。空链 = 连 L0 都
    不可证（provable_to=None）。
    """
    layers = [KIND_LAYER.get(e.get("kind", ""), None) for e in events]
    layers = [l for l in layers if l in _LAYER_ORDER]
    if not layers:
        return {"provable_to": None, "beyond": "Unknown"}
    deepest = max(layers, key=_LAYER_ORDER.index)
    if deepest == "L5":
        return {"provable_to": "L5", "beyond": ""}
    return {"provable_to": deepest, "beyond": "Unknown"}


def read_events(path):
    """读 PROP-EVT 流（.gz 或普通文件）。返回 (events, truncated)。"""
    path = Path(path)
    truncated = False
    events = []
    opener = gzip.open if path.suffix == ".gz" else open
    try:
        with opener(path, "rt", errors="replace") as f:
            for line in f:
                evt = parse_line(line)
                if evt is not None:
                    events.append(evt)
    except (EOFError, gzip.BadGzipFile, OSError):
        # Z_SYNC_FLUSH 前缀可救；截断标记（abort 样本契约）
        truncated = True
    return events, truncated
